scope: Exploratory joint physical-parameter uncertainty and link-noise pilot, not certification.
parameter_distribution: Independent uniform relative [-epsilon,+epsilon] per cell, per port and per parameter; fixed across acquisition and both evaluations.
conditions: Gate-on model only. Same fixed physical field for a seed in its quiet and noisy uncertain arms. No claim about gate necessity or superiority to hybrid.
retention: Freeze learned gains and b at test. Reset q=.1. All failed acquisitions retained.
comparisons: Paired uncertainty effect at each noise regime, paired total noise effect at each uncertainty regime, interaction. Counts descriptive by independent network seed.
work: Nine model-work integrals, positive finite-path reserve bound. No detailed E trajectory.
stop: Fixed pilot only; stop on solver/audit failure. Never skip/replace seeds or automatically enlarge.
proof_limit: Six random physical draws are not coverage of the parameter box. Unbounded Gaussian amplitude noise admits no deterministic all-noise guarantee. No initial-state box uncertainty is claimed.

randomness.physical_field: One independent uniform draw per parameter per cell per port, reused without change in both uncertain arms and throughout acquisition and test.
randomness.noise_pairing: Same deterministic counter-based latent field for matched nominal and uncertain arms, indexed by network seed, layer, lane, port, stage, source/event label and occurrence. Divergent traffic can query different keys; realized downstream input trains need not be identical.
randomness.stage_separation: Acquisition stage 0; test stage 8001. Disjoint stage keys. Baseline and decoy tests share stage 8001. No noise field is redrawn in response to outcomes.
randomness.independence: Physical field uses Python random.Random(202610260000+seed); link field uses the preserved mix64/Box-Muller counter generator with separate stage keys. Independent sampling streams by construction, not a statistical independence theorem for the PRNG.

fixed_outcome_definitions.transmission_presence: Fraction of 128 source identities present on 12 output lanes, based on passive tags; also report stricter once-only ordered pure-source coverage.
fixed_outcome_definitions.complete_word: All 128 source identities occur exactly once in chronological order on every lane; exactly 128 outputs per lane and no extra or ambiguous event. Report complete lanes and complete networks.
fixed_outcome_definitions.extra_emissions: Baseline pure-source duplicate occurrences and other outputs separately. Mixed versus matched baseline: ordered maximum-cardinality matching within tolerance 2, then minimize total absolute shifts; report additions AND removals. Additions may include displaced events and are not automatically proven false spikes.
fixed_outcome_definitions.timing_error: Relative interval error (observed consecutive-source gap minus source gap)/source gap, using pairs of adjacent source identities each occurring once as a pure tag. Report RMS, maximum absolute error, and valid pair count. Invalid/missing pairs remain failures in transmission and are excluded from timing estimates, never assigned zero error. No acceptance threshold is invented after observing outcomes.
fixed_outcome_definitions.statistics: Descriptive paired effects by independent network seed. No superiority/noninferiority threshold or significance test; six seeds cannot establish box-wide guarantees.

failure_handling: Every scheduled seed retained. Biological/model transmission failures are reported from successful solver outputs. Simulator refusal, overlap, regeneration failure, resource-bound failure, numeric failure, timeout or audit failure are recorded separately as SIMULATOR_FAILURE; preserve stderr/traceback and stop without replacing or excluding the seed.
